question: Do nearby separate same-class detections supply scale information for distinguishing coordinate actions that the anchor itself cannot provide?
difference: Uses other distinct instances in the SAME image, rather than other views of the same anchor, image pixels, DFL bins or pooled view-error moments. No continuation of those stopped recipes.
sample: Original candidate18 first128 fitting/64 head-held-out train images. Evaluate both splits descriptively; only the64 head-held-out gate decides.
context: Frozen regret output boxes and unchanged calibrated scores/classes. For each original anchor, same-class peers atscore>=.25, exclude ALL peers with IoU>=.1 to the original anchor, then take up to8 nearest by center distance within.20 original-image diagonal. Require4 local peers and4 global peers. Target anchor, its duplicate aliases and GT never enter context.

scores.local_scale: Negative mean absolute difference between action log(width,height) and the coordinate-wise median log(width,height) of eligible nearby peers.
scores.global_scale: Same statistic using all eligible same-class peers across the image, excluding overlap aliases.
scores.reference_distance: Negative mean absolute coordinate displacement from frozen regret action, normalized by ORIGINAL calibrated anchor width/height.

pair_protocol: Owned anchors atscore>=.05, >=2 valid actions, local context available. Compare every valid action to frozen regret choice against the SAME original owned nominal GT. Exclude regret action and nominal abs IoU gain<=.01. Score each alternative relative to that same reference. Each eligible anchor gets total comparison weight1, avoiding overweighting large action menus.
pass_action: Allows separately registered matched small residual-head pilot with local context, global context and shuffled-context controls, all initialized from frozen regret. No detector training or official evaluation from this screen alone.
fail_action: Stop this local-scale-median representation without changing neighbor radius, class filter, peer score, count, scale statistic or action subset.
budget: 192 cached frames, zero images decoded, zero detector forwards/training, no fitting, CPU geometry only.
priors: Object relations, perspective-aware scale priors and contextual localization already exist. Neither local neighbors nor median scale consistency alone is claimed novel. Literature review must identify an implementable distinction if information passes.
limits: Peers can be wrong detections or different physical object sizes; view and pose affect apparent shape. This is univariate action AUC conditional on existing ownership/context, not final detection AP or proof of incremental conditional information. Frozen cache already inherits diagnostic ignore filtering. Detector saw these training scenes; repeated head holdout is not independent validation.
